title.zh: 卷一百八十六下 列傳第一百三十六下: 酷吏下
title.raw: 卷一百八十六下 列傳第一百三十六下: 酷吏下 Volume 186 Biographies 136: Cruel Officials 2

sentences.zh: 姚紹之

translations.literal: Yao Shaozhi.
translations.idiomatic: Yao Shaozhi.

sentences.zh: 姚紹之，湖州武康人也。

translations.literal: Yao Shaozhi was a man of Wukang in Hu Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Yao Shaozhi was a native of Wukang in Hu Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 解褐典儀，累拜監察御史。

translations.literal: Upon leaving the purple he served as ceremonial officer, and through repeated promotions was appointed Investigating Censor.
translations.idiomatic: Upon entering service he was a ceremonial officer and rose through repeated promotions to Investigating Censor.

sentences.zh: 中宗朝，武三思恃庶人勢，駙馬都尉王同皎謀誅之。

translations.literal: In the reign of Emperor Zhongzong, Wu Sansi relied on the deposed empress's power; Chief Commandant of Horse Wang Tongjiao plotted to execute him.
translations.idiomatic: Under Emperor Zhongzong, Wu Sansi relied on the deposed empress's power, and Chief Commandant of Horse Wang Tongjiao plotted to kill him.

sentences.zh: 事泄，令紹之按問而誅同皎。

translations.literal: When the plot was exposed, Shaozhi was ordered to investigate and Tongjiao was executed.
translations.idiomatic: When the plot leaked out, Shaozhi was ordered to investigate the case and execute Tongjiao.

sentences.zh: 紹之初按問同皎，張仲之、祖延慶謀衣袖中發調弩射三思，伺其便，未果。

translations.literal: When Shaozhi first investigated Tongjiao, Zhang Zhongzhi and Zu Yanqing plotted to fire a crossbow hidden in their sleeves at Sansi when an opportunity arose, but did not succeed.
translations.idiomatic: At the start of Shaozhi's investigation of Tongjiao, Zhang Zhongzhi and Zu Yanqing plotted to shoot Sansi with a crossbow concealed in their sleeves when the moment came, but they failed.

sentences.zh: 宋之遜以其外妹妻延慶，曰：「今日將行何事，而以妻為？」

translations.literal: Song Zhisun gave his wife's younger sister in marriage to Yanqing, saying: "What business are we about today, that you would take a wife?"
translations.idiomatic: Song Zhisun gave his wife's younger sister to Yanqing in marriage, saying, "What important business are we undertaking today, that you would take a wife?"

sentences.zh: 之遜固抑與延慶，且洽其心矣。

translations.literal: Zhisun firmly pressed her on Yanqing and also won his heart.
translations.idiomatic: Zhisun pressed the marriage on Yanqing and thereby won his confidence.

sentences.zh: 之遜子曇密發之，乃敕右臺大夫李承嘉與紹之按於新開門內。

translations.literal: Zhisun's son Tan secretly reported it, and an edict ordered Right Censor-in-Chief Li Chengjia and Shaozhi to investigate inside the Xinkai Gate.
translations.idiomatic: Zhisun's son Tan secretly reported the plot, and an edict ordered Right Censor-in-Chief Li Chengjia and Shaozhi to investigate inside the Xinkai Gate.

sentences.zh: 初，紹之將直盡其事。

translations.literal: At first Shaozhi intended to investigate the matter to the full.
translations.idiomatic: At first Shaozhi meant to get to the bottom of the affair.

sentences.zh: 詔宰相李嶠等對問。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the chancellor Li Jiao and others to join the interrogation.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Chancellor Li Jiao and others to join the interrogation.

sentences.zh: 諸相懼三思威權，但僶俛佯不問。

translations.literal: The chief ministers feared Sansi's power and authority, and only bowed their heads and pretended not to inquire.
translations.idiomatic: The chief ministers feared Sansi's power and merely bowed their heads, feigning ignorance.

sentences.zh: 仲之、延慶言曰：「宰相中有附會三思者。」

translations.literal: Zhongzhi and Yanqing said: "Among the chancellors are those who attach themselves to Sansi."
translations.idiomatic: Zhongzhi and Yanqing said, "Some of the chancellors are in Sansi's pocket."

sentences.zh: 嶠與承嘉耳言，復說誘紹之，其事乃變。

translations.literal: Jiao and Chengjia whispered in each other's ears, again persuaded and tempted Shaozhi, and the affair then changed.
translations.idiomatic: Jiao and Chengjia whispered together, then persuaded and coaxed Shaozhi, and the case took a different turn.

sentences.zh: 遂密置人力十餘，命引仲之對問。

translations.literal: Thereupon more than ten strongmen were secretly posted, and Zhongzhi was ordered brought forth for questioning.
translations.idiomatic: Shaozhi then secretly posted more than ten brutes and had Zhongzhi brought out for questioning.

sentences.zh: 至，即為紹之所擒，塞口反接，送獄中。

translations.literal: When he arrived, Shaozhi immediately seized him, stuffed his mouth, bound his arms behind his back, and sent him to prison.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhongzhi arrived, Shaozhi seized him at once, gagged him, bound his arms behind his back, and sent him to prison.

sentences.zh: 紹之還，謂仲之曰：「張三，事不諧矣！」

translations.literal: Shaozhi returned and said to Zhongzhi: "Zhang the Third, the affair will not succeed!"
translations.idiomatic: Shaozhi came back and said to Zhongzhi, "Zhang the Third, it's over!"

sentences.zh: 仲之固言三思反狀，紹之命棒之而臂折，大呼天者六七。

translations.literal: Zhongzhi insisted on stating Sansi's rebellious conduct; Shaozhi ordered him beaten until his arm broke, and he cried to Heaven six or seven times.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongzhi kept describing Sansi's treasonous conduct. Shaozhi ordered him beaten until his arm broke, and he cried to Heaven six or seven times.

sentences.zh: 謂紹之曰：「反賊，臂且折矣，命已輸汝，當訴爾於天帝！」

translations.literal: He said to Shaozhi: "Rebel traitor, my arm is already broken, my life is already yours — I shall accuse you before the Lord of Heaven!"
translations.idiomatic: He said to Shaozhi, "Rebel traitor, my arm is broken and my life is already yours — I will accuse you before the Lord of Heaven!"

sentences.zh: 因裂衫以束之，乃自誣反而遇誅。

translations.literal: Thereupon he tore his robe to bind the arm, then falsely incriminated himself for rebellion and met execution.
translations.idiomatic: He tore his robe to bind the broken arm, then falsely confessed to rebellion and was executed.

sentences.zh: 紹之自此神氣自若，朝廷側目。

translations.literal: From this time Shaozhi was calm and self-possessed in spirit, and the court looked askance at him.
translations.idiomatic: From then on Shaozhi carried himself with unruffled arrogance, and the court looked on him with alarm.

sentences.zh: 累遷左臺侍御史。

translations.literal: Through repeated promotions he was made Left Censor.
translations.idiomatic: He was repeatedly promoted to Left Censor.

sentences.zh: 奉使江左，經汴州，辱錄事參軍魏傳弓。

translations.literal: On a mission to the lower Yangtze, passing through Bian Prefecture, he publicly humiliated Army Records Officer Wei Chuanggong.
translations.idiomatic: On a mission to the lower Yangtze he passed through Bian Prefecture and publicly humiliated Army Records Officer Wei Chuanggong.

sentences.zh: 尋拜監察御史。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he was appointed Investigating Censor.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon appointed Investigating Censor.

sentences.zh: 紹之後坐贓汙，詔傳弓按之，獲贓五千餘貫以聞，當坐死。

translations.literal: Later Shaozhi was implicated for bribery and corruption; an edict ordered Chuanggong to investigate him. More than five thousand strings of illicit goods were obtained and reported; by law he deserved death.
translations.idiomatic: Later Shaozhi was implicated in bribery and corruption. An edict ordered Chuanggong to investigate him. More than five thousand strings in bribes were found and reported; by law he deserved death.

sentences.zh: 韋庶人妹保持之，遂黜放為嶺南瓊山尉。

translations.literal: The younger sister of the deposed Empress Wei interceded for him, and he was dismissed and exiled as Assistant Magistrate of Qiongshan in Lingnan.
translations.idiomatic: The deposed Empress Wei's younger sister interceded for him, and he was dismissed and exiled as assistant magistrate of Qiongshan in Lingnan.

sentences.zh: 傳弓初按紹之，紹之在揚州，色動，謂長吏盧萬石曰：「頃辱傳弓，今為所按，紹之死矣！」

translations.literal: When Chuanggong first investigated Shaozhi, Shaozhi was in Yang Prefecture. His countenance changed, and he said to Chief Administrator Lu Wanshi: "I recently humiliated Chuanggong; now that he is investigating me, Shaozhi is dead!"
translations.idiomatic: When Chuanggong first began to investigate him, Shaozhi was in Yang Prefecture. His face changed color, and he told Chief Administrator Lu Wanshi, "I humiliated Chuanggong not long ago — now that he is investigating me, I am a dead man!"

sentences.zh: 逃入西京，為萬年尉擒之，擊折其足，因授南陵令員外置。

translations.literal: He fled into the Western Capital, was captured by the Wannian Assistant Magistrate, was struck until his foot broke, and was then given the post of Magistrate of Nanling as a supernumerary appointment.
translations.idiomatic: He fled to the Western Capital, was caught by the Wannian assistant magistrate, was beaten until his leg broke, and was then given the supernumerary post of magistrate of Nanling.

sentences.zh: 開元十三年，累轉括州長史同正員，不預知州事，死。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year of Kaiyuan, through repeated transfers he became Co-Administrator of Kuozhou, was not permitted to participate in prefectural affairs, and died.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year of Kaiyuan he rose through repeated transfers to co-administrator of Kuozhou, was barred from governing the prefecture, and died there.

sentences.zh: 周利貞

translations.literal: Zhou Lizhen.
translations.idiomatic: Zhou Lizhen.

sentences.zh: 周利貞，神龍初為侍御史。

translations.literal: Zhou Lizhen, at the beginning of Shenlong, served as Censor.
translations.idiomatic: At the start of Shenlong, Zhou Lizhen served as censor.

sentences.zh: 附托權要，為桓彥範、敬暉等五王嫉之，出為嘉州司馬。

translations.literal: He attached himself to powerful patrons; Huan Yanfan, Jing Hui, and the other Five Princes resented him, and he was sent out as Military Administrator of Jia Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He curried favor with the powerful. Huan Yanfan, Jing Hui, and the other Five Princes despised him and had him posted out as military administrator of Jia Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 時中書舍人崔湜與桓、敬善。

translations.literal: At the time Secretariat Drafter Cui Shi was on good terms with Huan and Jing.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Secretariat Drafter Cui Shi was on good terms with Huan and Jing.

sentences.zh: 武三思用事禁中，彥範憂之，托心腹於湜。

translations.literal: Wu Sansi wielded power within the inner palace; Yanfan was troubled by it and entrusted his trusted plan to Shi.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Sansi wielded power inside the palace. Yanfan was alarmed and confided his plan to Shi.

sentences.zh: 湜反露其計於三思，為三思所中，盡流嶺南。

translations.literal: Shi in turn exposed their plan to Sansi; they were trapped by Sansi, and all were exiled to Lingnan.
translations.idiomatic: Shi betrayed the plan to Sansi. Sansi turned the trap on them, and all were exiled to Lingnan.

sentences.zh: 湜勸盡殺之。

translations.literal: Shi urged that they all be killed.
translations.idiomatic: Shi urged that they all be killed.

sentences.zh: 以絕其歸望。

translations.literal: To cut off any hope of their return.
translations.idiomatic: This was to cut off any hope of their return.

sentences.zh: 三思問：「誰可使者？」

translations.literal: Sansi asked: "Who can be sent for this?"
translations.idiomatic: Sansi asked, "Who can be sent for this?"

sentences.zh: 利貞即湜之表兄，因舉為此行。

translations.literal: Lizhen was Shi's cousin on his mother's side, and on that account was recommended for this mission.
translations.idiomatic: Lizhen was Shi's maternal cousin and was recommended for the mission on that account.

sentences.zh: 利貞至，皆鴆殺之，因擢為左臺御史中丞。

translations.literal: When Lizhen arrived, he poisoned them all to death, and was thereupon promoted to Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: When Lizhen arrived he poisoned them all to death and was promoted to Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 先天元年，為廣州都督。

translations.literal: In the first year of Xiantian, he served as Regional Inspector of Guang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Xiantian he served as regional inspector of Guang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 時湜為中書令，與僕射劉幽求不葉，陷幽求徙於嶺表，諷利貞殺之，為桂州都督王晙護之，逗留獲免。

translations.literal: At the time Shi was Chief Minister of the Secretariat; he was at odds with Vice Director Liu Youqiu, framed Youqiu and had him exiled beyond the mountains, and hinted that Lizhen should kill him. Youqiu was protected by Regional Inspector Wang Jun of Gui Prefecture and, detained there, escaped death.
translations.idiomatic: Shi was then chief minister of the Secretariat and at odds with Vice Director Liu Youqiu. He framed Youqiu and had him exiled beyond the mountains, hinting that Lizhen should kill him. Youqiu was protected by Wang Jun, regional inspector of Gui Prefecture, and by being detained there escaped death.

sentences.zh: 無何，玄宗正位，利貞與薛季昶、宋之問同賜死於桂州驛。

translations.literal: Before long, when Emperor Xuanzong took the throne, Lizhen was together with Xue Jichang and Song Zhiwen granted death at the post station in Gui Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Before long, after Emperor Xuanzong took the throne, Lizhen was executed together with Xue Jichang and Song Zhiwen at the post station in Gui Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 王旭

translations.literal: Wang Xu.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Xu.

sentences.zh: 王旭，太原祁人也。

translations.literal: Wang Xu was a man of Qi in Taiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Xu was a native of Qi in Taiyuan commandery.

sentences.zh: 曾祖珪，貞觀初為侍中，尚永寧公主。

translations.literal: His great-grandfather Gui, in the early Zhenguan era, served as Chief Minister and married Princess Yongning.
translations.idiomatic: His great-grandfather Wang Gui, in the early Zhenguan era, served as chief minister and married Princess Yongning.

sentences.zh: 旭解褐鴻州參軍，轉兗州兵曹。

translations.literal: Xu, upon leaving the purple, served as Army Records Officer of Hong Prefecture and was transferred to Army Records Officer of Yan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Upon entering service Xu was army records officer of Hong Prefecture and was transferred to army records officer of Yan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 神龍元年正月，張柬之、桓彥範等誅張易之、昌宗兄弟，尊立孝和皇帝。

translations.literal: In the first month of the first year of Shenlong, Zhang Jianzhi, Huan Yanfan, and others executed Zhang Yizhi and the Chang brothers and installed Emperor Xiaohe as ruler.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the first year of Shenlong, Zhang Jianzhi, Huan Yanfan, and others executed Zhang Yizhi and the Chang brothers and installed Emperor Xiahe on the throne.

sentences.zh: 其兄昌儀先貶乾封尉，旭斬之，賫其首，赴於東都。

translations.literal: His elder brother Changyi had first been demoted to Assistant Magistrate of Qianfeng; Xu beheaded him, carried his head, and hastened to the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: His elder brother Changyi had already been demoted to assistant magistrate of Qianfeng. Xu beheaded him, carried off the head, and hastened to the Eastern Capital.

sentences.zh: 遷并州錄事參軍。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Army Records Officer of Bing Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to army records officer of Bing Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 唐隆元年，玄宗誅韋庶人等。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tanglong, Emperor Xuanzong executed the deposed Empress Wei and her faction.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Tanglong, Emperor Xuanzong executed the deposed Empress Wei and her faction.

sentences.zh: 并州長史周仁軌，韋氏之黨，有詔誅之。

translations.literal: Chief Administrator Zhou Rengui of Bing Prefecture was a partisan of the Wei clan; an edict ordered his execution.
translations.idiomatic: Chief Administrator Zhou Rengui of Bing Prefecture was a partisan of the Wei clan, and an edict ordered his execution.

sentences.zh: 旭不覆敕，又斬其首，馳赴西京。

translations.literal: Xu did not await confirmation of the edict, again beheaded him, carried the head, and galloped to the Western Capital.
translations.idiomatic: Xu did not wait for confirmation of the edict, beheaded Zhou at once, and galloped to the Western Capital with the head.

sentences.zh: 開元二年，累遷左臺侍御史。

translations.literal: In the second year of Kaiyuan, through repeated promotions he was made Left Censor.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Kaiyuan he rose through repeated promotions to Left Censor.

sentences.zh: 時光祿少卿盧崇道以崔湜妻父，貶於嶺外。

translations.literal: At the time Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices Lu Chongdao, as father-in-law of Cui Shi, was demoted beyond the mountains.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices Lu Chongdao, as Cui Shi's father-in-law, had been demoted beyond the mountains.

sentences.zh: 逃歸，匿於東都，為仇家所發，詔旭究其獄。

translations.literal: He fled back and hid in the Eastern Capital; an enemy family reported him, and an edict ordered Xu to investigate the case to completion.
translations.idiomatic: He fled back and hid in the Eastern Capital. An enemy family reported him, and an edict ordered Xu to investigate the case to completion.

sentences.zh: 旭欲擅其威權，因捕崇道親黨數十人，皆極其楚毒，然後結成其罪。

translations.literal: Xu wished to monopolize awe-inspiring authority; he therefore captured dozens of Chongdao's relatives and associates, exhausted them with extreme torture, and only then fixed their guilt.
translations.idiomatic: Xu wished to wield awe-inspiring authority alone. He captured dozens of Chongdao's relatives and associates, tortured them to the limit, and only then fixed their guilt.

sentences.zh: 崇道及三子並杖死於都亭驛，門生親友皆決杖流貶。

translations.literal: Chongdao and his three sons were all beaten to death at the Duting Post Station; students, close friends, and others were all sentenced to beating and exile or demotion.
translations.idiomatic: Chongdao and his three sons were all beaten to death at the Duting Post Station; students, close friends, and others were all sentenced to beating and exile or demotion.

sentences.zh: 時得罪多是知名之士，四海冤之。

translations.literal: At the time many of those implicated were well-known men, and the realm lamented the injustice.
translations.idiomatic: Many of those implicated were celebrated men, and the realm lamented the injustice.

sentences.zh: 旭又與御史大夫李傑不葉，遞相糾訐，傑竟左遷衢州刺史。

translations.literal: Xu was also at odds with Censor-in-Chief Li Jie; they repeatedly impeached each other, and Jie was finally demoted to the left as Prefect of Qu Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Xu also feuded with Censor-in-Chief Li Jie. They repeatedly impeached each other until Jie was demoted to prefect of Qu Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 旭既得誌，擅行威福，由是朝廷畏而鄙之。

translations.literal: Once Xu had gotten his wish, he acted on his own authority and wielded awe and privilege; from this the court both feared and despised him.
translations.idiomatic: Once Xu had gotten his way he acted on his own authority and wielded awe and privilege, and the court both feared and despised him.

sentences.zh: 五年，遷左司郎中，常帶侍御史。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he was transferred to Director of the Left Department, usually holding concurrent service as censor.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he was made director of the Left Department, usually with concurrent service as censor.

sentences.zh: 旭為吏嚴苛，左右無敢支梧，每銜命推劾，一見無不輸款者。

translations.literal: Xu was severe and harsh as an official; those around him dared not resist. Whenever he received orders to investigate, at first sight none failed to confess.
translations.idiomatic: As an official Xu was severe and harsh; none around him dared resist. In every case he handled, prisoners confessed at first sight.

sentences.zh: 時宋王憲府掾紀希虬兄任劍南縣令，被告有贓私，旭使至蜀鞫之。

translations.literal: At the time an official of Prince Xian of Song's staff, Ji Xiqiao's elder brother, served as Magistrate of Jiannan County and was reported for bribery and private gain; Xu was sent to Shu to interrogate him.
translations.idiomatic: Ji Xiqiao's elder brother, an official on Prince Xian of Song's staff and magistrate of Jiannan County, was reported for bribery. Xu was sent to Shu to interrogate him.

sentences.zh: 其妻美，旭威逼之，因奏決殺縣令，納贓數千萬。

translations.literal: His wife was beautiful; Xu coerced her, then memorialized that the magistrate should be executed and accepted bribes of tens of millions.
translations.idiomatic: The man's wife was beautiful. Xu coerced her, then memorialized for the magistrate's execution and accepted bribes of tens of millions.

sentences.zh: 至六年，希虬遣奴詐為祗承人，受顧在臺，事旭累月。

translations.literal: By the sixth year, Xiqiao sent a slave disguised as an imperial messenger to serve in the censorate and attend on Xu for several months.
translations.idiomatic: By the sixth year Xiqiao sent a slave disguised as an imperial messenger to serve in the censorate and attend on Xu for several months.

sentences.zh: 旭賞之，召入宅中，委以腹心。

translations.literal: Xu rewarded him, summoned him into his residence, and entrusted him with his innermost affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Xu rewarded him, summoned him into his house, and entrusted him with his innermost affairs.

sentences.zh: 其奴密記旭受饋遺囑托事，乃成數千貫，歸謁希虬。

translations.literal: The slave secretly recorded Xu's acceptance of bribes and entrusted requests, amounting to several thousand strings, and returned to show Xiqiao.
translations.idiomatic: The slave secretly recorded Xu's bribes and favors owed, amounting to several thousand strings, and returned to show Xiqiao.

sentences.zh: 希虬銜泣見憲，敘以家冤。

translations.literal: Xiqiao, weeping, saw the prince and recounted the family wrong.
translations.idiomatic: Xiqiao wept before the prince and recounted his family's wrong.

sentences.zh: 憲憫之，執其狀以奏，詔付臺司劾之。

translations.literal: The prince took pity on him, held the document and memorialized upward; an edict ordered the censorate to investigate.
translations.idiomatic: The prince took pity on him, took the record and reported it to the throne, and an edict ordered the censorate to investigate.

sentences.zh: 贓私累巨萬，貶龍平尉，憤恚而死，甚為時人之所慶快。

translations.literal: Private bribes totaled tens of millions; he was demoted to Assistant Magistrate of Longping, died of rage and resentment, and the age greatly rejoiced.
translations.idiomatic: His private bribes totaled tens of millions. He was demoted to assistant magistrate of Longping, died of rage and resentment, and contemporaries rejoiced greatly.

sentences.zh: 吉溫

translations.literal: Ji Wen.
translations.idiomatic: Ji Wen.

sentences.zh: 吉溫，天官侍郎頊弟琚之孽子也。

translations.literal: Ji Wen was the illegitimate son of Ji Jun, younger brother of Vice Director of the Heavenly Office Ji Xu.
translations.idiomatic: Ji Wen was the illegitimate son of Ji Jun, younger brother of Vice Director of the Heavenly Office Ji Xu.

sentences.zh: 譎詭能諂事人，遊於中貴門，愛若親戚。

translations.literal: Cunning and deceitful, he was skilled at flattering and serving men; he moved among the inner eunuchs and was loved like a kinsman.
translations.idiomatic: Cunning and deceitful, he was skilled at fawning on others and moved among the inner eunuchs, who treated him like kin.

sentences.zh: 性禁害，果於推劾。

translations.literal: By nature he was harmful and forbidding, and resolute in investigation.
translations.idiomatic: By nature he was malicious and forbidding, and ruthless in investigation.

sentences.zh: 天寶初，為新豐丞。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Tianbao, he served as Assistant Magistrate of Xinfeng.
translations.idiomatic: At the start of Tianbao he served as assistant magistrate of Xinfeng.

sentences.zh: 時太子文學薛嶷承恩幸，引溫入對。

translations.literal: At the time Crown Prince Literary Scholar Xue Yi enjoyed imperial favor and introduced Wen for audience.
translations.idiomatic: Crown Prince Literary Scholar Xue Yi, then in favor, introduced Wen to the emperor.

sentences.zh: 玄宗目之而謂嶷曰：「是一不良漢，朕不要也。」

translations.literal: Emperor Xuanzong looked at him and said to Yi: "This is a bad fellow — I do not want him."
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Xuanzong looked him over and said to Yi, "This is a bad character — I do not want him."

sentences.zh: 時蕭炅為河南尹，河南府有事，京臺差溫推詰，事連炅，堅執不舍，賴炅與右相李林甫善，抑而免之。

translations.literal: At the time Xiao Jiong was Henan Intendant; the Henan office had a matter, and the capital censorate sent Wen to investigate and question. The affair implicated Jiong; Wen firmly held to it without yielding. Jiong was on good terms with Right Chancellor Li Linfu, who suppressed the matter and Wen was spared.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Xiao Jiong was Henan Intendant. When a matter at the Henan office arose, the capital censorate sent Wen to investigate. The case implicated Jiong, and Wen pressed it without yielding. Jiong was protected by Right Chancellor Li Linfu, who suppressed the matter and spared Wen.

sentences.zh: 及溫選，炅已為京兆尹，一唱萬年尉，即就其官，人為危之。

translations.literal: When Wen was selected for transfer, Jiong had already become Jingzhao Intendant; with one announcement he was made Wannian Assistant Magistrate, and Wen immediately took up the post — people regarded it as perilous.
translations.idiomatic: When Wen was transferred, Jiong had already become Jingzhao Intendant and promptly made him assistant magistrate of Wannian. Wen took the post at once, and people regarded it as perilous.

sentences.zh: 時驃騎高力士常止宿宮禁，或時出外第，炅必謁焉。

translations.literal: At the time Flying Cavalry General Gao Lishi often lodged in the palace precincts; sometimes he went out to his outer residence, and Jiong always called on him.
translations.idiomatic: Flying Cavalry General Gao Lishi often lodged in the palace and sometimes visited his outer residence, which Jiong always attended.

sentences.zh: 溫先馳與力士言謔甚洽，握手呼行第，炅覷之嘆伏。

translations.literal: Wen rode ahead and spoke jestingly with Lishi in great harmony, clasped hands and called him by familiar rank; Jiong saw it and sighed in submission.
translations.idiomatic: Wen rode ahead, chatted familiarly with Lishi, and clasped his hand using intimate terms of address. Jiong saw this and sighed in submission.

sentences.zh: 及他日，溫謁炅於府庭，遽布心腹曰：「他日不敢隳國家法，今日已後，洗心事公。」

translations.literal: On another day Wen called on Jiong in the office courtyard and suddenly declared to his trusted followers: "On other days I would not dare destroy the law of the state; from today onward I will cleanse my heart and serve you, my lord."
translations.idiomatic: On another day Wen came to Jiong's office and suddenly told his trusted followers, "Before today I would not have dared violate the law of the state. From now on I will serve you with a clean heart, my lord."

sentences.zh: 炅復與盡歡。

translations.literal: Jiong again received him with full cordiality.
translations.idiomatic: Jiong received him with full cordiality.

sentences.zh: 會林甫與左相李適之、駙馬張垍不葉，適之兼兵部尚書，垍兄均為兵部侍郎，林甫遣人訐出兵部銓曹主簿事令史六十餘人偽濫事，圖覆其官長，詔出付京兆府與憲司對問。

translations.literal: Linfu was at odds with Left Chancellor Li Shizhi and Chief Commandant of Horse Zhang Ji. Shizhi also held the post of Minister of War; Ji's elder brother Jun was Vice Minister of War. Linfu sent men to expose more than sixty appointment clerks of the Ministry of War's Selection Bureau for false appointments, intending to overturn their superiors. An edict ordered the case sent to Jingzhao Prefecture and the censorate for joint questioning.
translations.idiomatic: Linfu was at odds with Left Chancellor Li Shizhi and Chief Commandant of Horse Zhang Ji. Shizhi also headed the Ministry of War, and Zhang Ji's elder brother Jun was vice minister. Linfu had clerks expose more than sixty appointment clerks in the Ministry of War for false appointments, intending to bring down their superiors. An edict ordered Jingzhao and the censorate to investigate jointly.

sentences.zh: 數日，竟不究其由。

translations.literal: After several days they still did not get to the bottom of the reason.
translations.idiomatic: After several days they still could not get to the bottom of it.

sentences.zh: 炅使溫劾之。

translations.literal: Jiong had Wen investigate.
translations.idiomatic: Jiong had Wen investigate.

sentences.zh: 溫於院中分囚於兩處，溫於後廳佯取兩重囚訊之，或杖或壓，痛苦之聲，所不忍聞。

translations.literal: In the courtyard Wen divided the prisoners into two places. In the rear hall he pretended to take two serious prisoners for questioning; some were beaten, some crushed, and the sounds of pain were unbearable to hear.
translations.idiomatic: In the courtyard Wen divided the prisoners into two groups. In a back hall he pretended to interrogate two serious offenders; some were beaten, some crushed, and the sounds of agony were unbearable.

sentences.zh: 即云：「若存性命，乞紙盡答。」

translations.literal: He then said: "If you wish to preserve life, beg paper and answer fully."
translations.idiomatic: He then said, "If you wish to keep your lives, ask for paper and confess fully."

sentences.zh: 令史輩素諳溫，各自誣伏罪，及溫引問，無敢違者。

translations.literal: The clerks had long known Wen; each falsely confessed guilt, and when Wen brought them forward for questioning none dared disobey.
translations.idiomatic: The clerks had long known Wen. Each falsely confessed, and when Wen brought them forward for questioning none dared disobey.

sentences.zh: 晷刻間事輯，驗囚無栲訊決罰處。

translations.literal: Within a short span the affair was complete; on examination the prisoners showed no place of beating or punishment.
translations.idiomatic: Within a short span the case was closed, and on inspection the prisoners bore no marks of beating or punishment.

sentences.zh: 常云：「若遇知己，南山白額獸不足縛也。」

translations.literal: He often said: "If I meet one who knows my worth, the white-browed beast of the southern mountains is not enough to bind."
translations.idiomatic: He often said, "Give me a patron who knows my worth, and not even the white-browed tiger of the southern mountains would be beyond my grasp."

sentences.zh: 會李林甫將起刑獄，除不附己者，乃引之於門，與羅希奭同鍛煉詔獄。

translations.literal: When Li Linfu was about to launch criminal cases and remove those not attached to himself, he brought Wen into his patronage, and together with Luo Xiyi he forged cases in the edict-designated prisons.
translations.idiomatic: When Li Linfu was about to launch criminal prosecutions and remove those not loyal to him, he took Wen under his patronage. Together with Luo Xiyi he forged cases in the edict-designated prisons.

sentences.zh: 五載，因中官納其外甥武敬一女為盛王琦妃，擢京兆府士曹。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, through an inner eunuch he presented a daughter born to him by Wu Jing to be consort to Prince Sheng Qi, and was promoted to Capital Corps Officer of Jingzhao.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, through an inner eunuch he presented a daughter he had by Wu Jing as consort to Prince Sheng Qi and was promoted to capital corps officer of Jingzhao.

sentences.zh: 時林甫專謀不利於東儲，以左驍衛兵曹柳湜杜良娣妹婿，令溫推之。

translations.literal: At the time Linfu exclusively plotted against the Eastern Heir Apparent. Left Martial Guard Officer Liu Ji was son-in-law to Consort Du Liangdi's younger sister; Linfu ordered Wen to investigate him.
translations.idiomatic: Linfu was then plotting against the crown prince. Left Martial Guard Officer Liu Ji was son-in-law to Consort Du Liangdi's younger sister, and Linfu ordered Wen to investigate him.

sentences.zh: 溫追著作郎王曾、前右司禦率府倉曹王修己、左武衛司戈盧寧、左威衛騎曹徐徵同就臺鞫，數日而獄成。

translations.literal: Wen pursued Composition Officer Wang Zeng, former Right Gate Imperial Guard Storehouse Officer Wang Xiuji, Left Martial Guard Officer Lu Ning, and Left Guard Cavalry Officer Xu Zheng, all brought together to the censorate for interrogation; within several days the case was complete.
translations.idiomatic: Wen pursued Composition Officer Wang Zeng, former Right Gate Imperial Guard Storehouse Officer Wang Xiuji, Left Martial Guard Officer Lu Ning, and Left Guard Cavalry Officer Xu Zheng, bringing them together to the censorate for interrogation. Within days the case was closed.

sentences.zh: 勣等杖死，積屍於大理寺。

translations.literal: Ji and the others were beaten to death; corpses piled up in the Court of Judicial Review.
translations.idiomatic: Ji and the others were beaten to death, and corpses piled up in the Court of Judicial Review.

sentences.zh: 六載，林甫又以戶部侍郎、兼御史中丞楊慎矜違忤其旨，御史中丞王鉷與慎矜親而嫉之，同構其事，云：「蓄圖讖，以己是隋煬帝子孫，規於興復」，林甫又奏付溫鞫焉，慎矜下獄繫之。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, Linfu also had Vice Minister of Revenue and concurrent Vice Censor-in-Chief Yang Shenjin defy his intent. Vice Censor-in-Chief Wang Hong was related to Shenjin but jealous of him; together they constructed the affair, saying: "He hoards prognostic texts and, taking himself to be a descendant of Emperor Yang of Sui, plots restoration." Linfu again memorialized that Wen should interrogate the case; Shenjin was imprisoned and bound.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year Linfu also had Vice Minister of Revenue and concurrent Vice Censor-in-Chief Yang Shenjin defy his wishes. Vice Censor-in-Chief Wang Hong was related to Shenjin but jealous of him; together they fabricated a case, saying, "He hoards prognostic texts and, taking himself to be a descendant of Emperor Yang of Sui, plots restoration." Linfu again memorialized that Wen should interrogate the case, and Shenjin was imprisoned.

sentences.zh: 使溫於東京收捕其兄少府少監慎餘、弟洛陽令慎名，於汝州捕其門客史敬忠。

translations.literal: Wen was sent to the Eastern Capital to capture Shenjin's elder brother, Vice Director of the Palace Workshop Yang Shenyu, and his younger brother, Magistrate of Luoyang Yang Shenming; in Ru Prefecture he captured his retainer Shi Jingzhong.
translations.idiomatic: Wen was sent to the Eastern Capital to capture Shenjin's elder brother, Vice Director of the Palace Workshop Yang Shenyu, and his younger brother, Magistrate of Luoyang Yang Shenming; in Ru Prefecture he captured retainer Shi Jingzhong.

sentences.zh: 敬忠頗有學，嘗與朝貴遊。

translations.literal: Jingzhong was quite learned and had once associated with court nobles.
translations.idiomatic: Jingzhong was learned and had once moved among court nobles.

sentences.zh: 蹉跎不進。

translations.literal: He drifted without advancement.
translations.idiomatic: He had drifted without advancement.

sentences.zh: 與溫父琚情契甚密，溫孩孺時，敬忠嘗抱撫之。

translations.literal: He was deeply bound in friendship with Wen's father Jun; when Wen was a child Jingzhong had once held and caressed him.
translations.idiomatic: He had been deeply bound in friendship with Wen's father Jun and had once held and caressed Wen as a child.

sentences.zh: 溫令河南丞姚開就擒之，鎖其頸，布袂蒙面以見溫。

translations.literal: Wen ordered Henan Assistant Director Yao Kai to go capture him, locked his neck in chains, covered his face with cloth sleeves, and brought him before Wen.
translations.idiomatic: Wen ordered Henan Assistant Director Yao Kai to capture him, chained his neck, covered his face with cloth, and brought him before Wen.

sentences.zh: 溫驅之於前，不交一言。

translations.literal: Wen drove him forward without exchanging a single word.
translations.idiomatic: Wen drove him forward without exchanging a single word.

sentences.zh: 欲及京，使典誘之云：「楊慎矜今款招己成，須子一辨。

translations.literal: Wishing to reach the capital, he had an officer entice him, saying: "Yang Shenjin has already fully confessed and the case is complete; I need your one word of identification.
translations.idiomatic: Before reaching the capital he had an officer entice Jingzhong, saying, "Yang Shenjin has already fully confessed and the case is complete. I need one word of identification from you.

sentences.zh: 若解人意，必活；

translations.literal: If you understand what is wanted, you will surely live;
translations.idiomatic: If you understand what is wanted, you will live;

sentences.zh: 忤之，必死。」

translations.literal: if you resist, you will surely die.""
translations.idiomatic: if you resist, you will die.""

sentences.zh: 敬忠回首曰：「七郎，乞一紙。」

translations.literal: Jingzhong turned his head back and said: "Seventh Brother, I beg one sheet of paper."
translations.idiomatic: Jingzhong turned his head and said, "Seventh Brother, give me one sheet of paper."

sentences.zh: 溫佯不與，見詞懇，乃於桑下令答，三紙辯皆符溫旨。

translations.literal: Wen pretended not to give it; seeing the words earnest, he then gave it to him under the mulberry tree to answer — three sheets of defense all matched Wen's intent.
translations.idiomatic: Wen pretended not to give it; seeing how earnest he was, he finally gave him paper under a mulberry tree. Three sheets of defense all matched Wen's intent.

sentences.zh: 喜曰：「丈人莫相怪！」

translations.literal: Delighted, he said: "Elder sir, do not take offense!"
translations.idiomatic: Delighted, he said, "Elder sir, do not take offense!"

sentences.zh: 遂徐下拜。

translations.literal: Thereupon he slowly bowed down.
translations.idiomatic: Then he bowed low.

sentences.zh: 及至溫湯，始鞫慎矜，以敬忠詞為證。

translations.literal: When they reached Wen's hot springs, he first interrogated Shenjin, using Jingzhong's words as evidence.
translations.idiomatic: When they reached Wen's hot springs he first interrogated Shenjin, using Jingzhong's words as evidence.

sentences.zh: 及再搜其家，不得圖讖。

translations.literal: On searching his house again, no prognostic text was found.
translations.idiomatic: On searching his house again, no prognostic text was found.

sentences.zh: 林甫恐事泄，危之，乃使御史盧鉉入搜。

translations.literal: Linfu feared the affair would leak and be endangered; he therefore had Censor Lu Xuan enter to search.
translations.idiomatic: Linfu feared the affair would leak and had Censor Lu Xuan search the house.

sentences.zh: 鉉乃袖讖書而入，於隱僻中詬而出曰：「逆賊牢藏秘記，今得之矣！」

translations.literal: Xuan then concealed the prognostic book in his sleeve and entered; in a hidden place he cursed and brought it forth, saying: "The rebel traitor firmly hid this secret record — now it is obtained!"
translations.idiomatic: Xuan concealed the prognostic book in his sleeve and entered. In a hidden place he cursed and brought it forth, saying, "The rebel traitor firmly hid this secret record — now it is obtained!"

sentences.zh: 指於慎矜小妻韓珠團婢，見舉家惶懼，且行捶擊，誰敢忤焉！

translations.literal: He pointed at Shenjin's younger wife, the maid Han Zhutuan; seeing the whole household fearful, he proceeded with beating, and who dared resist!
translations.idiomatic: He pointed at Shenjin's younger wife, the maid Han Zhutuan. Seeing the whole household terrified, he beat them, and none dared resist.

sentences.zh: 獄乃成，慎矜兄弟賜死。

translations.literal: The case was then complete; Shenjin and his brothers were granted death.
translations.idiomatic: The case was then closed; Shenjin and his brothers were ordered to die.

sentences.zh: 溫自是威振，衣冠不敢偶言。

translations.literal: From this time Wen's awe was shaking; officials and gentry dared not speak even in passing.
translations.idiomatic: From then on Wen's authority was terrifying, and officials and gentry dared not speak even in passing.

sentences.zh: 溫早以嚴毒聞，頻知詔獄，忍行枉濫，推事未訊問，已作奏狀，計贓數。

translations.literal: Wen had early been known for severity and poison; he frequently handled edict-designated prison cases, endured to carry out wrongful excess, and before the matter was interrogated had already prepared the memorial and calculated the amount of bribes.
translations.idiomatic: Wen had long been known for severity and poison. He frequently handled edict-designated prison cases, willingly committing wrongful excess. Before interrogation he had already prepared the memorial and calculated the bribe totals.

sentences.zh: 及被引問，便懾懼，即隨意而書，無敢惜其生者。

translations.literal: Once brought forward for questioning, they were awed and fearful and wrote as pleased, none daring to spare their lives.
translations.idiomatic: Once brought forward for questioning, prisoners were so terrified they wrote whatever was wanted, none daring to hold back.

sentences.zh: 因不加栲擊，獄成矣。

translations.literal: Thus without adding beating, the case was complete.
translations.idiomatic: Thus without even resorting to beating, the case was closed.

sentences.zh: 林甫深以溫為能，擢戶部郎中，常帶御史。

translations.literal: Linfu deeply regarded Wen as capable and promoted him to Director of the Ministry of Revenue, usually holding concurrent service as censor.
translations.idiomatic: Linfu deeply regarded Wen as capable and promoted him to director of the Ministry of Revenue with concurrent service as censor.

sentences.zh: 林甫雖倚以爪牙，溫又見安祿山受主恩，驃騎高力士居中用事，皆附會其間，結為兄弟。

translations.literal: Although Linfu relied on him as a claw and fang, Wen also saw that An Lushan received the sovereign's favor, Flying Cavalry Gao Lishi held power at the center, and all attached themselves among them, forming brotherhood.
translations.idiomatic: Although Linfu relied on him as a tool, Wen also saw that An Lushan enjoyed the emperor's favor and Gao Lishi held power at court. He attached himself to them all and formed brotherhood with them.

sentences.zh: 常謂祿山曰：「李右相雖觀察人事，親於三兄，必不以兄為宰相。

translations.literal: He often said to Lushan: "Right Chancellor Li may observe human affairs and be close to you, Third Brother, yet he will surely not make you, Brother, chancellor.
translations.idiomatic: He often said to Lushan, "Right Chancellor Li may read men and be close to you, Third Brother, yet he will surely not make you chancellor.

sentences.zh: 溫雖被驅使，必不超擢。

translations.literal: Although Wen is driven and used, he will surely not be promoted beyond measure.
translations.idiomatic: Although I am driven and used, I will surely not be promoted beyond measure.

sentences.zh: 若三兄奏溫為相，即奏兄堪大任，擠出林甫，是兩人必為相矣。」

translations.literal: If you, Third Brother, memorialize Wen as chancellor, I will memorialize that Brother is fit for great appointment, squeeze out Linfu — then the two of us will surely both become chancellors."
translations.idiomatic: If you, Third Brother, recommend me as chancellor, I will recommend you for a great appointment and squeeze out Linfu — then the two of us will surely both become chancellors."

sentences.zh: 祿山悅之。

translations.literal: Lushan was pleased.
translations.idiomatic: Lushan was delighted.

sentences.zh: 時祿山承恩無敵，驟言溫能，玄宗亦忘曩歲之語。

translations.literal: At the time Lushan enjoyed favor without rival and suddenly praised Wen's ability; Emperor Xuanzong also forgot his words of years before.
translations.idiomatic: Lushan then enjoyed unrivaled favor and quickly praised Wen's ability; Emperor Xuanzong also forgot his judgment of years before.

sentences.zh: 十載，祿山加河東節度，因奏溫為河東節度副使，並知節度營田及管內采訪監察留後事。

translations.literal: In the tenth year Lushan was additionally made Military Commissioner of Hedong; he therefore memorialized Wen as Deputy Military Commissioner of Hedong, concurrently managing circuit garrison farms and internal investigation, and overseeing remaining affairs as acting commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year Lushan was additionally made military commissioner of Hedong. He memorialized Wen as his deputy, with charge of garrison farms and internal investigation and oversight of affairs in his absence.

sentences.zh: 其載，又加兼雁門太守，仍知安邊郡鑄錢事，賜紫金魚袋。

translations.literal: In that year he was additionally made Prefect of Yanmen, still managing frontier coinage in the Anbian Commandery, and was granted the purple robe and gold fish tally.
translations.idiomatic: That year Wen was additionally made prefect of Yanmen and put in charge of frontier coinage in Anbian Commandery, and was granted the purple robe and gold fish tally.

sentences.zh: 及丁所生憂，祿山又奏起復為本官。

translations.literal: When he completed mourning for his birth mother, Lushan again memorialized that he should leave mourning and resume his former office.
translations.idiomatic: When he completed mourning for his birth mother, Lushan again memorialized that he leave mourning and resume his former office.

sentences.zh: 尋復奏為魏郡太守、兼侍御史。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he again memorialized Wen as Prefect of Wei Commandery, concurrently serving as censor.
translations.idiomatic: He soon memorialized Wen again as prefect of Wei Commandery with concurrent service as censor.

sentences.zh: 楊國忠入相，素與溫交通，追入為御史中丞，仍充京畿、關內采訪處置使。

translations.literal: When Yang Guozhong entered the chancellorship, he had long been in contact with Wen and recalled him as Vice Censor-in-Chief, still serving as Commissioner for Investigation and Disposition in the Capital Region and Guannei.
translations.idiomatic: When Yang Guozhong became chancellor he had long been in contact with Wen and recalled him as vice censor-in-chief, still serving as commissioner for investigation and disposition in the capital region and Guannei.

sentences.zh: 溫於范陽辭，祿山令累路館驛作白䌷帳以候之，又令男慶緒出界送，攏馬出驛數十步。

translations.literal: When Wen took leave at Fanyang, Lushan ordered relay stations along the route to set up white silk canopies to await him, and also ordered his son Qingxu to escort him beyond the border, holding the horses and going several tens of paces out from the post station.
translations.idiomatic: When Wen took leave at Fanyang, Lushan ordered relay stations along the route to erect white silk canopies to receive him and had his son Qingxu escort him beyond the border, holding the horses dozens of paces from the post station.

sentences.zh: 及至西京，朝廷動靜，輒報祿山，信宿而達。

translations.literal: When he reached the Western Capital, he reported every movement of the court to Lushan, and within one or two nights it arrived.
translations.idiomatic: Once he reached the Western Capital he reported every movement of the court to Lushan, and word arrived within a day or two.

sentences.zh: 十三載正月，祿山入朝，拜左僕射，充閑廄使。

translations.literal: In the first month of the thirteenth year, Lushan came to court, was appointed Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, and was made Commissioner of the Imperial Stud.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the thirteenth year Lushan came to court, was appointed left vice director of the Department of State Affairs, and was made commissioner of the imperial stud.

sentences.zh: 因奏加溫武部侍郎、兼御史中丞，充閑廄、苑內、營田、五坊等副使。

translations.literal: He thereupon memorialized that Wen be additionally made Vice Minister of War and concurrent Vice Censor-in-Chief, and Deputy Commissioner of the Imperial Stud, Inner Parks, Garrison Farms, and Five Corrals.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized that Wen be additionally made vice minister of war and concurrent vice censor-in-chief, and deputy commissioner of the imperial stud, inner parks, garrison farms, and five corrals.

sentences.zh: 時楊國忠與祿山嫌隙已成，溫轉厚於祿山，國忠又忌之。

translations.literal: At the time Yang Guozhong and Lushan had already formed a rift; Wen turned even closer to Lushan, and Guozhong again resented him.
translations.idiomatic: By then Yang Guozhong and Lushan were already at odds. Wen drew even closer to Lushan, and Guozhong resented him again.

sentences.zh: 其冬，河東太守韋陟入奏於華清宮，陟自謂失職，托於溫結歡於祿山，廣載河東土物饋於溫，又及權貴。

translations.literal: That winter Hedong Prefect Wei Zhi came to memorialize at Huaqing Palace. Zhi considered himself to have lost his post and, relying on Wen, sought favor with Lushan, broadly loading Hedong local products as gifts for Wen and also for the powerful.
translations.idiomatic: That winter Hedong Prefect Wei Zhi came to memorialize at Huaqing Palace. Believing he had lost his post, Zhi relied on Wen to seek favor with Lushan, loading Hedong local products as gifts for Wen and other powerful men.

sentences.zh: 國忠諷評事吳豸之使鄉人告之，召付中書門下，對法官鞫之，陟伏其狀，貶桂嶺尉，溫澧陽長史。

translations.literal: Guozhong hinted to Assessor Wu Zhizhi to have a fellow townsman report it; they were summoned and handed over to the Secretariat and Chancellery, interrogated jointly before the legal officers; Zhi confessed to the facts of the case, was demoted to Assistant Magistrate of Guiling, and Wen to Chief Administrator of Liyang.
translations.idiomatic: Guozhong hinted to Assessor Wu Zhizhi to have a fellow townsman report the matter. They were summoned to the Secretariat and Chancellery and interrogated before legal officers. Zhi confessed and was demoted to assistant magistrate of Guiling; Wen was demoted to chief administrator of Liyang.

sentences.zh: 溫判官員錫新興尉。

translations.literal: Wen's judicial officer Yuan Xi was demoted to Assistant Magistrate of Xinxing.
translations.idiomatic: Wen's judicial officer Yuan Xi was demoted to assistant magistrate of Xinxing.

sentences.zh: 明年，溫又坐贓七千匹及奪人口馬奸穢事發，貶端州高要尉。

translations.literal: The next year Wen was again implicated for seven thousand bolts of illicit goods and for seizing people, horses, and debauched misconduct; he was demoted to Assistant Magistrate of Gaoyao in Duan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The next year Wen was again implicated for seven thousand bolts of illicit goods and for seizing people, horses, and debauched misconduct. He was demoted to assistant magistrate of Gaoyao in Duan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 溫至嶺外，遷延不進，依於張博濟，止於始安郡。

translations.literal: When Wen reached the region beyond the mountains he delayed and did not proceed, relying on Zhang Boji, and stopped in Shian Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: When Wen reached the region beyond the mountains he delayed and did not proceed, relying on Zhang Boji, and stopped in Shian Commandery.

sentences.zh: 八月，遣大理司直蔣沇鞫之。

translations.literal: In the eighth month Court of Judicial Review Direct Attendant Jiang Yan was sent to interrogate him.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Court of Judicial Review Direct Attendant Jiang Yan was sent to interrogate him.

sentences.zh: 溫死於獄中，博濟及始安太守羅希奭死於州門。

translations.literal: Wen died in prison; Boji and Shian Prefect Luo Xiyi died at the prefectural gate.
translations.idiomatic: Wen died in prison; Boji and Shian Prefect Luo Xiyi died at the prefectural gate.

sentences.zh: 初，溫之貶斥，玄宗在華清宮，謂朝臣曰：「吉溫是酷吏子侄，朕被人誑惑，用之至此。

translations.literal: At first, when Wen was demoted and expelled, Emperor Xuanzong was at Huaqing Palace and said to the court ministers: "Ji Wen is the nephew of a cruel official. I was deceived into using him to this extent.
translations.idiomatic: When Wen was first demoted, Emperor Xuanzong was at Huaqing Palace and said to the court ministers, "Ji Wen is the nephew of a cruel official. I was deceived into using him to this extent.

sentences.zh: 屢勸朕起刑獄以作威福，朕不受其言。

translations.literal: He repeatedly urged me to launch criminal cases to make awe and privilege; I did not accept his words.
translations.idiomatic: He repeatedly urged me to launch criminal cases to wield awe and privilege, and I did not accept his words.

sentences.zh: 今去矣，卿等皆可安枕也！」

translations.literal: Now he is gone; you all may finally sleep at ease!"
translations.idiomatic: Now he is gone; you all may finally sleep at ease!"

sentences.zh: 初，開元九年，有王鈞為洛陽尉。

translations.literal: At the beginning, in the ninth year of Kaiyuan, there was Wang Jun serving as Assistant Magistrate of Luoyang.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning, in the ninth year of Kaiyuan, Wang Jun served as assistant magistrate of Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 十八年，有嚴安之為河南丞。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year there was Yan Anzhi serving as Assistant Director of Henan.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year Yan Anzhi served as assistant director of Henan.

sentences.zh: 皆性毒虐，笞罰人畏其不死，皆杖訖不放起，須其腫憤，徐乃重杖之，懊血流地，苦楚欲死，鈞與安之始眉目喜暢，故人吏懾懼。

translations.literal: Both were by nature poisonous and cruel; in beating and punishing men they feared the victims would not die. After the beating was finished they would not let them rise, waiting until the swelling festered, then slowly beating them again until blood flowed on the ground and agony made death seem desirable — only then did Jun and Anzhi show cheerful brows and eyes; old officials and clerks were awed and fearful.
translations.idiomatic: Both were poisonous and cruel by nature. When beating prisoners they feared the victims might not die. After each beating they would not let them rise, waited until the swelling festered, then beat them again until blood ran on the ground and agony made death seem preferable — only then did Jun and Anzhi look pleased. Old officials and clerks were terrified.

sentences.zh: 溫則售身權貴，噬螫衣冠，來頗異耳。

translations.literal: Wen, by contrast, sold himself to the powerful and nobility and bit and stung officials and gentry — his coming was quite different.
translations.idiomatic: Wen, by contrast, sold himself to the powerful and preyed on officials and gentry — a rather different kind of cruelty.

sentences.zh: 溫九月死始興。

translations.literal: Wen died at Shixing in the ninth month.
translations.idiomatic: Wen died at Shixing in the ninth month.

sentences.zh: 十一月，祿山起兵作亂，人謂與溫報仇耳。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month Lushan raised troops and made rebellion; people said it was to avenge Wen.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Lushan raised troops in rebellion; people said it was to avenge Wen.

sentences.zh: 祿山入洛陽城，即偽位。

translations.literal: When Lushan entered Luoyang he immediately usurped the throne.
translations.idiomatic: When Lushan entered Luoyang he immediately usurped the throne.

sentences.zh: 玄宗幸蜀後，祿山求得溫一子，才六七歲，授河南府參軍，給與財帛。

translations.literal: After Emperor Xuanzong went to Shu, Lushan sought out one of Wen's sons, only six or seven years old, appointed him Army Records Officer of Henan Prefecture, and gave him goods and silk.
translations.idiomatic: After Emperor Xuanzong went to Shu, Lushan found one of Wen's sons, only six or seven years old, appointed him army records officer of Henan Prefecture, and gave him goods and silk.

sentences.zh: 初，溫之按楊慎矜，侍御史盧鉉同其事。

translations.literal: At first, when Wen investigated Yang Shenjin, Palace Censor Lu Xuan shared the affair.
translations.idiomatic: When Wen investigated Yang Shenjin, Palace Censor Lu Xuan shared the affair.

sentences.zh: 鉉初為御史，作韋堅判官。

translations.literal: At first Xuan served as censor and was judicial officer for Wei Jian.
translations.idiomatic: At first Xuan served as censor and was judicial officer for Wei Jian.

sentences.zh: 及堅為李林甫所嫉，鉉以堅款曲發於林甫，冀售其身。

translations.literal: When Jian was resented by Li Linfu, Xuan exposed Jian's full confession to Linfu, hoping to sell himself.
translations.idiomatic: When Jian was targeted by Li Linfu, Xuan exposed Jian's full confession to Linfu, hoping to save himself.

sentences.zh: 及按慎矜，鉉先與張瑄同臺，情旨素厚，貴取媚於權臣，誣瑄與楊慎矜共解圖讖。

translations.literal: When investigating Shenjin, Xuan had first served on the same censorate platform as Zhang Xuan and their sentiments had long been thick; valuing currying favor with powerful ministers, he falsely charged Xuan with jointly interpreting prognostic texts with Yang Shenjin.
translations.idiomatic: When investigating Shenjin, Xuan had served on the same censorate platform as Zhang Xuan and they had long been close. Eager to curry favor with powerful ministers, he falsely charged Xuan with jointly interpreting prognostic texts with Yang Shenjin.

sentences.zh: 持之，為驢駒板橛以成其獄。

translations.literal: Holding it up, he made a donkey-foal stake-board to complete the case.
translations.idiomatic: He used this as a donkey-foal stake-board to complete the case.

sentences.zh: 又為王鉷閑廄判官，鉷緣邢縡事朝堂被推，鉉證云：「大夫將白帖索廄馬五百匹以助逆，我不與之。」

translations.literal: He also served as judicial officer for Wang Hong of the Imperial Stud; when Hong was pushed in the court hall over the Xing Ji affair, Xuan testified, saying: "The Chief Minister was about to send a white slip requesting five hundred stud horses to aid rebellion — I did not give them to him."
translations.idiomatic: He also served as judicial officer for Wang Hong of the Imperial Stud. When Hong was implicated in the court hall over the Xing Ji affair, Xuan testified, saying, "The chief minister was about to send a white slip requesting five hundred stud horses to aid rebellion — I did not give them to him."

sentences.zh: 鉷死在晷刻，鉉忍誣之，眾咸怒恨焉。

translations.literal: Hong died within a short span; Xuan cruelly bore false witness against him, and the multitude all raged and resented it.
translations.idiomatic: Hong died within moments. Xuan cruelly bore false witness against him, and everyone raged at the injustice.

sentences.zh: 及被貶為廬江長史，在郡忽見瑄為祟，乃云：「端公何得來乞命？

translations.literal: When he was demoted to Chief Administrator of Lujiang, in the commandery he suddenly saw Xuan as a haunting spirit and then said: "My lord, how have you come to beg for life?
translations.idiomatic: When he was demoted to chief administrator of Lujiang, he suddenly saw Xuan as a haunting spirit and said, "My lord, how have you come to beg for life?

sentences.zh: 不自由。」

translations.literal: I am not free."
translations.idiomatic: I am not free."

sentences.zh: 鉉須臾而卒。

translations.literal: Within a moment Xuan died.
translations.idiomatic: Within a moment Xuan died.

sentences.zh: 羅希奭

translations.literal: Luo Xiyi.
translations.idiomatic: Luo Xiyi.

sentences.zh: 羅希奭，本杭州人也，近家洛陽，鴻臚少卿張博濟堂外甥。

translations.literal: Luo Xiyi was originally a man of Hang Prefecture; his family had recently settled in Luoyang. He was a cousin on the paternal side of Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices Zhang Boji.
translations.idiomatic: Luo Xiyi was originally from Hang Prefecture; his family had recently settled in Luoyang. He was a paternal cousin of Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices Zhang Boji.

sentences.zh: 為吏持法深刻。

translations.literal: As an official he upheld the law with deep severity.
translations.idiomatic: As an official he enforced the law with deep severity.

sentences.zh: 天寶初，右相李林甫引與吉溫持獄，又與希奭姻婭，自御史臺主簿再遷殿中侍御史。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Tianbao, Right Chancellor Li Linfu brought him together with Ji Wen to handle prison cases; he was also related to Xiyi by marriage, and from Chief Clerk of the Censorate he was again promoted to Palace Censor.
translations.idiomatic: At the start of Tianbao Right Chancellor Li Linfu brought him together with Ji Wen to handle prison cases. He was also related to Xiyi by marriage and rose from chief clerk of the censorate to palace censor.

sentences.zh: 自韋堅、皇甫惟明、李適之、柳勣、裴敦復、李邕、鄔元昌、楊慎矜、趙奉璋下獄事，皆與溫鍛煉，故時稱「羅鉗吉網」，惡其深刻也。

translations.literal: From the imprisonment of Wei Jian, Huangfu Weiming, Li Shizhi, Liu Ji, Pei Dunfu, Li Yong, Wu Yuanchang, Yang Shenjin, and Zhao Fengzhang, all were forged together with Wen; therefore the age called them "Luo's Pincers and Ji's Net," hating their depth and severity.
translations.idiomatic: From the imprisonments of Wei Jian, Huangfu Weiming, Li Shizhi, Liu Ji, Pei Dunfu, Li Yong, Wu Yuanchang, Yang Shenjin, and Zhao Fengzhang, all were forged together with Wen. The age therefore called them "Luo's Pincers and Ji's Net," hating their depth and severity.

sentences.zh: 八載，除刑部員外，轉郎中。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he was appointed Vice Director of the Ministry of Justice and transferred to Director.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he was appointed vice director of the Ministry of Justice and transferred to director.

sentences.zh: 十一載，李林甫卒，出為中部、始安二太守，仍充當管經略使。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year Li Linfu died; he was sent out as Prefect of Zhongbu and Shian, still serving as Frontier Commissioner for the circuit under his charge.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year Li Linfu died. He was sent out as prefect of Zhongbu and Shian, still serving as frontier commissioner for the circuit under his charge.

sentences.zh: 十四載，以張博濟、吉溫，韋陟、韋誡奢、李從一、員錫等流貶，皆於始安，希奭或令假攝。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year, because Zhang Boji, Ji Wen, Wei Zhi, Wei Jieshe, Li Congyi, Yuan Xi, and others were exiled and demoted, all were at Shian; Xiyi sometimes had them act as temporary appointees.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year Zhang Boji, Ji Wen, Wei Zhi, Wei Jieshe, Li Congyi, Yuan Xi, and others were exiled and demoted to Shian; Xiyi sometimes had them serve as temporary appointees.

sentences.zh: 右相楊國忠奏遣司直蔣沇往按之，復令張光奇替為始安太守。

translations.literal: Right Chancellor Yang Guozhong memorialized sending Direct Attendant Jiang Yan to investigate, and again ordered Zhang Guangqi to replace him as Prefect of Shian.
translations.idiomatic: Right Chancellor Yang Guozhong memorialized sending Direct Attendant Jiang Yan to investigate and ordered Zhang Guangqi to replace him as prefect of Shian.

sentences.zh: 仍降敕曰：

translations.literal: An edict was also issued, stating:
translations.idiomatic: An edict was also issued, stating:

sentences.zh: 前始安郡太守、充當管經略使羅希奭，幸此資序，叨居牧守。

translations.literal: Former Prefect of Shian Commandery and Frontier Commissioner for the circuit under his charge Luo Xiyi, by fortune of this rank and sequence, presumptuously held the post of prefect and defender.
translations.idiomatic: Former prefect of Shian Commandery and frontier commissioner for the circuit under his charge Luo Xiyi, by fortune of rank and seniority, presumptuously held the post of prefect and defender.

sentences.zh: 地列要荒，人多竄殛，尤加委任，冀絕奸訛。

translations.literal: The land lies among strategic wilds; the people are many who flee and are executed. He was especially entrusted with added responsibility, hoping to cut off wickedness and error.
translations.idiomatic: The land lies in a strategic frontier region where many are fugitives and exiles. He was especially entrusted with responsibility, in the hope of cutting off wickedness and error.

sentences.zh: 翻乃嘯結逋逃，群聚不逞，應是流貶，公然安置。

translations.literal: On the contrary he gathered and joined fugitives; the unruly assembled in groups. All who should have been exiled and demoted he openly installed.
translations.idiomatic: Instead he gathered fugitives and assembled the unruly in groups. All who should have been exiled and demoted he openly installed.

sentences.zh: 或差攝郡縣，割剝黎氓；

translations.literal: Some he dispatched to act as prefects and magistrates, stripping and exploiting the common people;
translations.idiomatic: Some he dispatched to act as prefects and magistrates, stripping and exploiting the common people;

sentences.zh: 或輟借館宇，侵擾人吏。

translations.literal: some he lent official residences, harassing officials and clerks.
translations.idiomatic: some he lent official residences, harassing officials and clerks.

sentences.zh: 不唯輕侮典憲，實亦隳壞紀綱。

translations.literal: Not only did he lightly insult the canonical statutes; in truth he also destroyed discipline and regulation.
translations.idiomatic: He not only lightly insulted the canonical statutes; in truth he also destroyed discipline and regulation.

sentences.zh: 擢發數愆，豈多其罪，可貶海東郡海康尉、員外置。

translations.literal: When every fault is counted out, can his crimes be many? He may be demoted to Assistant Magistrate of Haikang in Haidong Commandery, supernumerary appointment.
translations.idiomatic: When every fault is counted, are his crimes not many enough? He is demoted to assistant magistrate of Haikang in Haidong Commandery as a supernumerary appointment.

sentences.zh: 張博濟往托回邪，跡惟憑恃，嘗自抵犯，又坐親姻，前後貶官，歲月頗久，逗留不赴，情狀難容。

translations.literal: Zhang Boji has long relied on crooked and wicked ways; his tracks show only dependence on patronage. He has repeatedly offended on his own and also been implicated through marriage; demoted repeatedly over many years, he has delayed and not reported — his conduct is hard to tolerate.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Boji has long relied on crooked and wicked ways and shows only dependence on patronage. He has repeatedly offended on his own and also been implicated through marriage. Demoted repeatedly over many years, he has delayed and not reported — conduct that is hard to tolerate.

sentences.zh: 及命按舉，仍更潛匿，亡命逭刑，莫斯為甚。

translations.literal: When ordered to investigate he still hid himself further; fleeing fate and evading punishment — nothing exceeds this.
translations.idiomatic: When ordered to investigate he still hid himself further — fleeing fate and evading punishment, nothing exceeds this.

sentences.zh: 並當切害，合峻常刑，宜於所在各決重杖六十。

translations.literal: All are to receive severe cutting harm and should receive stern regular punishment; each at his location is to be sentenced to sixty heavy blows with the staff.
translations.idiomatic: All are to receive severe punishment and should receive stern regular punishment. Each at his location is to be sentenced to sixty heavy blows with the staff.

sentences.zh: 使夫為政之士，克守章程；

translations.literal: Let the men who hold office each diligently guard the regulations;
translations.idiomatic: Let those who hold office each diligently guard the regulations;

sentences.zh: 負罪之人，期於悛革。

translations.literal: let men who bear guilt look to reform themselves.
translations.idiomatic: let those who bear guilt look to reform themselves.

sentences.zh: 凡厥在位，宜各悉心。

translations.literal: All who hold posts should each give their full heart.
translations.idiomatic: All who hold posts should each give their full heart.

sentences.zh: 時員錫、李從一、韋誡奢、吉承恩並決杖，遣司直宇文審往監之。

translations.literal: At the time Yuan Xi, Li Congyi, Wei Jieshe, and Ji Chengen were all sentenced to beating, and Direct Attendant Yu Wenshen was sent to supervise it.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Yuan Xi, Li Congyi, Wei Jieshe, and Ji Chengen were all sentenced to beating, and Direct Attendant Yu Wenshen was sent to supervise.

sentences.zh: 毛若虛

translations.literal: Mao Ruoxu.
translations.idiomatic: Mao Ruoxu.

sentences.zh: 毛若虛，絳州太平人也。

translations.literal: Mao Ruoxu was a man of Taiping in Jiang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Mao Ruoxu was a native of Taiping in Jiang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 眉毛覆於眼，其性殘忍。

translations.literal: His eyebrows covered his eyes; his nature was cruel and harsh.
translations.idiomatic: His eyebrows covered his eyes, and his nature was cruel and harsh.

sentences.zh: 初為蜀川縣尉，使司以推勾見任。

translations.literal: At first he served as Assistant Magistrate of Shuchuan County; the administrative office used him for investigation and verification while still in office.
translations.idiomatic: At first he served as assistant magistrate of Shuchuan County; the administrative office used him for investigation and verification while still in office.

sentences.zh: 天寶末，為武功丞，年已六十餘矣。

translations.literal: At the end of Tianbao he served as Assistant Magistrate of Wugong; he was already more than sixty years old.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of Tianbao he served as assistant magistrate of Wugong; he was already more than sixty years old.

sentences.zh: 肅宗收兩京，除監察御史。

translations.literal: When Emperor Suzong recovered the two capitals, Ruoxu was appointed Investigating Censor.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Suzong recovered the two capitals, Ruoxu was appointed Investigating Censor.

sentences.zh: 審國用不足，上策徵剝財貨。

translations.literal: Examining the state's insufficient revenue, he submitted a plan to levy and strip property.
translations.idiomatic: Finding state revenue insufficient, he submitted a plan to levy and strip property.

sentences.zh: 有潤於公者，日有進奉，漸見任用稱旨。

translations.literal: What enriched the public coffers was reported daily as tribute; he was gradually employed and met with approval.
translations.idiomatic: What enriched the public coffers was reported daily as tribute, and he was gradually employed to the emperor's satisfaction.

sentences.zh: 每推一人，未鞫，即先收其家資，以定贓數。

translations.literal: Whenever he investigated one man, before interrogation he first seized his household assets to fix the amount of bribes.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever he investigated a man, before interrogation he first seized his household assets to fix the bribe total.

sentences.zh: 不滿望，即攤徵鄉里近親。

translations.literal: If it did not meet his expectation, he then spread the levy to near kin in the village and neighborhood.
translations.idiomatic: If the amount did not meet his expectation, he then spread the levy to near kin in the village and neighborhood.

sentences.zh: 峻其威權，人皆懼死，輸納不差晷刻。

translations.literal: He made his awe-inspiring authority severe; all feared death and paid without missing by a short span of the day.
translations.idiomatic: He made his authority terrifying; all feared death and paid without missing a deadline.

sentences.zh: 乾元二年，鳳翔府七坊押官先行剽劫，州縣不能制，因有劫殺事。

translations.literal: In the second year of Qianyuan, the supervisory officer of the seven corrals of Fengxiang Prefecture went ahead in plundering; the prefectures and counties could not control them, and on that account there were robbery and killing affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Qianyuan the supervisory officer of the seven corrals of Fengxiang Prefecture led the way in plundering. The prefectures and counties could not control them, and robbery and killing followed.

sentences.zh: 縣尉謝夷甫因眾怒，遂搒殺之。

translations.literal: Assistant Magistrate Xie Yifu, because of the crowd's rage, thereupon beat them to death.
translations.idiomatic: Because of the crowd's rage, Assistant Magistrate Xie Yifu beat the offenders to death.

sentences.zh: 其妻訴於李輔國，輔國奏請御史孫瑩鞫之。

translations.literal: His wife appealed to Li Fuguo; Fuguo memorialized requesting Censor Sun Ying to interrogate the case.
translations.idiomatic: His wife appealed to Li Fuguo, who memorialized requesting Censor Sun Ying to interrogate the case.

sentences.zh: 瑩不能正其事。

translations.literal: Ying could not set the affair right.
translations.idiomatic: Ying could not set the affair right.

sentences.zh: 又令中丞崔伯陽三司使雜訊之，又不證成其罪。

translations.literal: He again ordered Vice Censor-in-Chief Cui Boyang as commissioner of the Three Offices to conduct mixed interrogation; again he could not verify the crime.
translations.idiomatic: He again ordered Vice Censor-in-Chief Cui Boyang as commissioner of the Three Offices to conduct mixed interrogation, but again could not verify the crime.

sentences.zh: 因令若虛推之，遂歸罪於夷甫。

translations.literal: He therefore ordered Ruoxu to investigate; the guilt was then placed on Yifu.
translations.idiomatic: He therefore ordered Ruoxu to investigate, and guilt was then placed on Yifu.

sentences.zh: 伯陽與之言，若虛頗不遜。

translations.literal: When Boyang spoke with him, Ruoxu was quite insubordinate.
translations.idiomatic: When Boyang spoke with him, Ruoxu was quite insubordinate.

sentences.zh: 伯陽數讓之，若虛馳謁告急。

translations.literal: Boyang repeatedly reproved him; Ruoxu galloped off to report an emergency.
translations.idiomatic: Boyang repeatedly reproved him; Ruoxu galloped off to report an emergency.

sentences.zh: 肅宗曰：「卿且出。」

translations.literal: Emperor Suzong said: "You may go out for now."
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Suzong said, "You may go out for now."

sentences.zh: 對曰：「臣出即死矣。」

translations.literal: He replied: "If your servant goes out, he will die at once."
translations.idiomatic: He replied, "If I go out, I will die at once."

sentences.zh: 肅宗潛留若虛簾內，召伯陽至，伯陽頗短若虛。

translations.literal: Emperor Suzong secretly kept Ruoxu inside the curtain, summoned Boyang, and Boyang spoke at length against Ruoxu.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Suzong secretly kept Ruoxu inside the curtain and summoned Boyang, who spoke at length against Ruoxu.

sentences.zh: 上怒，叱出之。

translations.literal: The emperor was angry and shouted him out.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was angry and shouted him out.

sentences.zh: 因流貶伯陽同推官十餘人，皆於嶺外遠惡處。

translations.literal: Thereupon Boyang and more than ten co-investigating officials were exiled and demoted to distant, evil places beyond the mountains.
translations.idiomatic: Boyang and more than ten co-investigating officials were exiled to distant, harsh places beyond the mountains.

sentences.zh: 宰相李峴以左右於瑩等，亦被貶斥。

translations.literal: Chancellor Li Xian, because he sided with Ying and the others, was also demoted and expelled.
translations.idiomatic: Chancellor Li Xian, because he sided with Ying and the others, was also demoted and expelled.

sentences.zh: 於是若虛威震朝列，公卿懾懼矣！

translations.literal: From this Ruoxu's awe shook the court ranks, and dukes and ministers were awed and fearful!
translations.idiomatic: From this Ruoxu's authority terrified the court, and dukes and ministers were awed and fearful.

sentences.zh: 尋擢為御史中丞。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he was promoted to Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon promoted to vice censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 上元元年，貶賓化尉而死。

translations.literal: In the first year of Shangyuan he was demoted to Assistant Magistrate of Binhua and died.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Shangyuan he was demoted to assistant magistrate of Binhua and died.

sentences.zh: 敬羽

translations.literal: Jing Yu.
translations.idiomatic: Jing Yu.

sentences.zh: 敬羽，寶鼎人也。

translations.literal: Jing Yu was a man of Baoding.
translations.idiomatic: Jing Yu was a native of Baoding.

sentences.zh: 父昭道，開元初為監察御史。

translations.literal: His father Zhaodao, in the early Kaiyuan era, served as Investigating Censor.
translations.idiomatic: His father Zhaodao, in the early Kaiyuan era, served as Investigating Censor.

sentences.zh: 羽貌寢而性便僻，善候人意旨。

translations.literal: Yu's appearance was homely and his nature was crooked and devious; he was skilled at reading men's intent.
translations.idiomatic: Yu was homely in appearance and crooked by nature, skilled at reading men's intent.

sentences.zh: 天寶九載，為康成縣尉。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Tianbao he served as Assistant Magistrate of Kangcheng.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year of Tianbao he served as assistant magistrate of Kangcheng.

sentences.zh: 安思順為朔方節度使，引在幕下。

translations.literal: An Sishun was Military Commissioner of Shuofang and brought him into his staff.
translations.idiomatic: An Sishun was military commissioner of Shuofang and brought him onto his staff.

sentences.zh: 及肅宗於靈武即大位，羽尋擢為監察御史。

translations.literal: When Emperor Suzong assumed the great position at Lingwu, Yu was soon promoted to Investigating Censor.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Suzong assumed the throne at Lingwu, Yu was soon promoted to Investigating Censor.

sentences.zh: 以苛刻徵剝求進。

translations.literal: He sought advancement through harsh exaction, stripping, and seeking.
translations.idiomatic: He sought advancement through harsh exaction and stripping.

sentences.zh: 及收兩京後，轉見委任。

translations.literal: After the two capitals were recovered he came increasingly to be entrusted.
translations.idiomatic: After the two capitals were recovered he came increasingly to be entrusted with power.

sentences.zh: 作大枷，有鹴尾榆，著即悶絕。

translations.literal: He made great cangues with salt-tail elm; when put on, one immediately suffocated.
translations.idiomatic: He made great cangues of salt-tail elm; when put on, a prisoner immediately suffocated.

sentences.zh: 又臥囚於地，以門關輾其腹，號為「肉餺飥」。

translations.literal: He also laid prisoners on the ground and rolled their bellies with a door bar — this was called "meat dumplings."
translations.idiomatic: He also laid prisoners on the ground and rolled their bellies with a door bar — this was called "meat dumplings."

sentences.zh: 掘地為坑，實以棘刺，以敗席覆上，領囚臨坑訊之，必墜其中，萬刺攢之。

translations.literal: He dug a pit in the ground, filled it with thorn brambles, covered it with a broken mat, led the prisoner to the edge of the pit for questioning, and he was sure to fall in — ten thousand thorns pierced him.
translations.idiomatic: He dug a pit, filled it with thorn brambles, covered it with a broken mat, led a prisoner to the edge for questioning, and he was sure to fall in — pierced by ten thousand thorns.

sentences.zh: 又捕逐錢貨，不減毛若虛。

translations.literal: He also hunted and pursued money and goods, no less than Mao Ruoxu.
translations.idiomatic: He also hunted and pursued money and goods, no less ruthlessly than Mao Ruoxu.

sentences.zh: 上元中，擢為御史中丞。

translations.literal: In the Shangyuan era he was promoted to Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the Shangyuan era he was promoted to vice censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 太子少傅、宗正卿、鄭國公李遵，為宗子通事舍人李若冰告其贓私，詔羽按之。

translations.literal: Heir Apparent Junior Tutor, Director of the Imperial Clan, and Duke of Zheng Li Zun was reported by Heir Apparent Communications Officer Li Ruobing for bribery and private gain; an edict ordered Yu to investigate.
translations.idiomatic: Heir Apparent Junior Tutor, Director of the Imperial Clan, and Duke of Zheng Li Zun was reported by Heir Apparent Communications Officer Li Ruobing for bribery. An edict ordered Yu to investigate.

sentences.zh: 羽延遵，各危坐於小床。

translations.literal: Yu summoned Zun; each sat upright on a small bed.
translations.idiomatic: Yu summoned Zun; each sat upright on a small bed.

sentences.zh: 羽小瘦，遵豐碩，頃間問即倒，請垂足。

translations.literal: Yu was small and thin; Zun was large and stout. Within a short span, when questioned he collapsed and asked that his feet be let down.
translations.idiomatic: Yu was small and thin; Zun was large and stout. Within a short span, when questioned he collapsed and asked that his feet be let down.

sentences.zh: 羽曰：「尚書下獄是囚，羽禮延坐，何得慢耶！」

translations.literal: Yu said: "When a chief minister enters prison he is a prisoner; Yu, observing ritual, extended a seat — how dare you be disrespectful!"
translations.idiomatic: Yu said, "When a chief minister enters prison he is a prisoner. Yu, observing ritual, extended a seat — how dare you be disrespectful!"

sentences.zh: 遵絕倒者數四。

translations.literal: Zun collapsed several times.
translations.idiomatic: Zun collapsed several times.

sentences.zh: 請問，羽徐應之，授紙筆，書贓數千貫，奏之。

translations.literal: When questioned, Yu slowly responded, gave him paper and brush, and had him write bribes of several thousand strings; he memorialized it.
translations.idiomatic: When questioned, Yu slowly responded, gave him paper and brush, and had him write bribes of several thousand strings, then memorialized it.

sentences.zh: 肅宗以勛舊舍之，但停宗正卿。

translations.literal: Emperor Suzong, because of meritorious old service, pardoned him but only removed him as Director of the Imperial Clan.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Suzong, because of meritorious old service, pardoned him but only removed him as director of the Imperial Clan.

sentences.zh: 及嗣薛王珍潛謀不軌，詔羽鞫之。

translations.literal: When Heir Apparent Prince of Si Zhen secretly plotted rebellion, an edict ordered Yu to interrogate him.
translations.idiomatic: When Heir Apparent Prince of Si Zhen secretly plotted rebellion, an edict ordered Yu to interrogate him.

sentences.zh: 羽召支黨羅於廷，索鹴尾榆枷之，布栲訊之具以繞之，信宿成獄。

translations.literal: Yu summoned Zhen's partisans and lined them up in the hall, sought the salt-tail elm cangue to bind them, and spread torture instruments around them; within one or two nights the case was complete.
translations.idiomatic: Yu summoned Zhen's partisans, lined them up in the hall, bound them in salt-tail elm cangues, and spread torture instruments around them. Within a day or two the case was closed.

sentences.zh: 珍坐死，右衛將軍竇如玢、試都水使者崔昌等九人並斬，太子洗馬趙非熊、陳王府長史陳閎、楚州司馬張昴、左武衛兵曹參軍焦自榮，前鳳翔府郿縣主簿李、廣文館進士張夐等六人決殺，駙馬都尉薛履謙賜自盡，左散騎常侍張鎬貶辰州司戶。

translations.literal: Zhen was sentenced to death; Right Guard General Dou Rubin, Acting Commissioner of Waterways Cui Chang, and nine others were all beheaded; Heir Apparent Reader Zhao Feixiong, Chief Administrator of the Prince of Chu's household Chen Hong, Military Administrator of Chu Prefecture Zhang Ang, Left Martial Guard Officer Jiao Zirong, former Chief Clerk of Fengxiang Prefecture's Mei County Li, and Advanced Scholar of the Broad Learning Hall Zhang Qiong — six men were sentenced to beating and execution; Chief Commandant of Horse Xue Lüqian was granted self-extermination; Left Regular Attendant Zhang Hao was demoted to Registrar of Chen Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Zhen was sentenced to death. Right Guard General Dou Rubin, Acting Commissioner of Waterways Cui Chang, and nine others were beheaded. Heir Apparent Reader Zhao Feixiong, chief administrator of the Prince of Chu's household Chen Hong, military administrator of Chu Prefecture Zhang Ang, Left Martial Guard Officer Jiao Zirong, former chief clerk of Fengxiang Prefecture's Mei County Li, and Advanced Scholar of the Broad Learning Hall Zhang Qiong — six men were beaten and executed. Chief Commandant of Horse Xue Lüqian was ordered to take his own life. Left Regular Attendant Zhang Hao was demoted to registrar of Chen Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 胡人康謙善賈，資產億萬計。
