translations.literal: The foreigner Kang Qian was skilled in trade; his assets numbered in the hundreds of millions.
translations.idiomatic: The foreigner Kang Qian was skilled in trade; his assets numbered in the hundreds of millions.

sentences.zh: 楊國忠為相，授安南都護。

translations.literal: When Yang Guozhong was chancellor, he was appointed Protector-General of Annan.
translations.idiomatic: When Yang Guozhong was chancellor, he was appointed protector-general of Annan.

sentences.zh: 至德中，為試鴻臚卿，專知山南東路。

translations.literal: In the Zede era he served as Acting Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, exclusively managing the Eastern Route of South of the Mountains.
translations.idiomatic: In the Zede era he served as acting vice director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, exclusively managing the eastern route south of the mountains.

sentences.zh: 驛人嫉之，告其陰通史朝義。

translations.literal: Relay workers resented him and reported that he secretly communicated with Shi Chaoyi.
translations.idiomatic: Relay workers resented him and reported that he secretly communicated with Shi Chaoyi.

sentences.zh: 謙髭鬚長三尺過帶，按之兩宿，鬢髮皆禿，膝踝亦栲碎，視之者以為鬼物，非人類也。

translations.literal: Qian's beard and mustache were more than three feet long, passing his belt. After one or two nights of investigation his temples and hair were all bald, and his knees and ankles were also crushed to pieces; those who saw him thought him a ghostly thing, not of the human kind.
translations.idiomatic: Qian's beard and mustache were more than three feet long, passing his belt. After a day or two of investigation his temples and hair were all gone and his knees and ankles were crushed to pieces. Those who saw him thought him a ghost, not human.

sentences.zh: 乞舍其生，以後送狀奏殺之，沒其資產。

translations.literal: He begged to spare his life; afterward he submitted a memorial requesting execution, and his assets were confiscated.
translations.idiomatic: He begged for his life; afterward he submitted a memorial requesting execution, and his assets were confiscated.

sentences.zh: 羽與毛若虛在臺五六年間，臺中囚繫不絕。

translations.literal: Yu and Mao Ruoxu, while at the censorate for five or six years, had prisoners continuously bound there.
translations.idiomatic: Yu and Mao Ruoxu, while at the censorate for five or six years, kept prisoners continuously bound there.

sentences.zh: 又有裴升、畢曜同為御史，皆酷毒。

translations.literal: There were also Pei Sheng and Bi Yao serving together as censors; all were cruel and poisonous.
translations.idiomatic: Pei Sheng and Bi Yao also served together as censors; all were cruel and poisonous.

sentences.zh: 人之陷刑，當時有毛、敬、裴、畢之稱。

translations.literal: When men fell into punishment, the age at the time had the names Mao, Jing, Pei, and Bi.
translations.idiomatic: When men fell into punishment, the age spoke of Mao, Jing, Pei, and Bi.

sentences.zh: 裴、畢尋又流黔中。

translations.literal: Pei and Bi were soon again exiled to central Qian.
translations.idiomatic: Pei and Bi were soon exiled again to central Qian.

sentences.zh: 羽，寶應元年貶為道州刺史。

translations.literal: Yu, in the first year of Baoying, was demoted to Prefect of Dao Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Baoying Yu was demoted to prefect of Dao Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 尋有詔殺之，羽聞之，衣兇服南奔溪洞，為吏所擒。

translations.literal: Soon an edict ordered his execution; when Yu heard it he put on mourning garments and fled south into ravines and caves, but was captured by officials.
translations.idiomatic: Soon an edict ordered his execution. When Yu heard it he put on mourning garments and fled south into ravines and caves but was captured by officials.

sentences.zh: 臨刑，袖中執州縣官吏犯贓私狀數紙，曰：「有人通此狀，恨不得推究其事。

translations.literal: Facing execution, from his sleeve he held several sheets recording prefectural and county officials' bribery and private gain, and said: "If anyone passes on this record, I regret that I could not investigate the affair.
translations.idiomatic: Facing execution, he held several sheets from his sleeve recording prefectural and county officials' bribery and private gain, and said, "If anyone passes on this record, I regret that I could not investigate the affair.

sentences.zh: 主州政者，無宜寢也。」

translations.literal: Those who hold prefectural government should not suppress it."
translations.idiomatic: Those who hold prefectural government should not suppress it."

sentences.zh: 贊曰：王德將衰，政在奸臣。

translations.literal: Commentary says: When royal virtue is about to decline, government lies with wicked ministers.
translations.idiomatic: Commentary: When royal virtue is about to decline, government lies with wicked ministers.

sentences.zh: 鷹犬搏擊，縱之者人。

translations.literal: Hawks and hounds strike and seize — it is men who set them loose.
translations.idiomatic: Hawks and hounds strike and seize — it is men who set them loose.

sentences.zh: 遭其毒螫，可為悲辛。

translations.literal: Those who suffer their poisonous sting may well grieve bitterly.
translations.idiomatic: Those who suffer their poisonous sting have cause for bitter grief.

sentences.zh: 作法為害，延濫不仁。

translations.literal: Making law to become harm spreads excess without benevolence.
translations.idiomatic: Making law into harm spreads cruelty without benevolence.
